# Belgium Wallonia: Parcellaire Agricole Anonyme

Belgium, Wallonia field boundaries (2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Inspire Geoportal of the European Commission. License: CC-BY-4.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/be_wal/latest/be_wal.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/be_wal/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:3035; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: geometry, hcat:code, crop:code, crop:name, id, hcat:name_en, hcat:name, metrics:area, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/be_wal/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/be_wal/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/be_wal/collection.json
